payload.name: Preserve all enumerated items during extraction
payload.description: When a source message lists multiple distinct traits, reasons, or motivations (joined by 'and' or commas), keep every listed item in extraction candidates and any memory update; do not drop an item unless it restates the same fact.
content: During extraction, when a message states several distinct facts in a list or conjunction (e.g., 'passionate about A and B' or 'because of X, Y, and Z'), preserve every enumerated item in the candidate; do not omit an item as redundant unless the speaker's wording clearly restates a single fact.

During CRUD, when an ADD or UPDATE targets a memory that lacks one of the items enumerated in the source message, include the missing item in the new or merged content; never let a later version drop a detail that remains supported by evidence.

solves: Extraction candidates sometimes summarize away one item from an enumerated list of traits, reasons, or motivations, so later memory cannot answer questions about the dropped item. This Skill applies whenever a future message lists multiple distinct attributes or motives that should all be recorded; it does not apply when the listed items are redundant paraphrases of a single fact or when the message contains no enumerable facts.
